evidence: Schema has 24 tables; portfolio uses only 2 (call_center, customer). 22 tables untouched including store_sales, catalog_sales, web_sales, inventory, all returns tables, item, promotion, date_dim, customer_address, customer_demographics
proposed_fix: Investigate why BUSINESS-vs-TECHNICAL filter excluded sales/fact/dim tables. Bug in filter prompt or classifier. Ensure fact tables marked TRANSACTIONAL, dim tables marked REFERENCE (not TECHNICAL).

evidence: No UC on sales/revenue (store_sales/web_sales/catalog_sales), no returns analysis, no inventory, no promotion effectiveness, no product-category UC, no date_dim time-series UC, no basket analysis via grouping id (ss_ticket_number). Every structural pattern failed to produce a UC.
proposed_fix: After portfolio completes, detect zero-coverage tables (%FACT/DIM not cited in any UC). If >20% of FACT tables unused, emit HIGH NEXT_ACTIONS + trigger rebalance pass.
fix_location: Phase Q5 WOW rebalance; Phase L new check L19_fact_table_coverage

evidence: 10 UCs, 0 Beneficiaries tied to Product/Marketing/Supply-Chain/Pricing/Returns. All Beneficiaries clustered in Operations/Finance/HR — a call-center-only portfolio masquerading as TPC-DS (which is retail/sales).
proposed_fix: Strengthen prompt §D STAKEHOLDER to require cross-functional representation; add Phase L L20_beneficiary_functional_spread (>=4 distinct functions if portfolio >=10 UCs).

evidence: K-Means on 5 features, 24 observations (call_center row count). Standard threshold is 50+ observations for 5-feature clustering; results will be unstable.
proposed_fix: Technique–data fit check: for Clustering techniques, flag UC if row_count < 10 * feature_count.
fix_location: Phase Q3 R2 — add cardinality check for Clustering/Classification/Forecasting

evidence: Claims JOIN call_center × customer 'on state/zip alignment' but customer lacks direct state/zip columns (has c_current_addr_sk FK to customer_address). JOIN is structurally unexecutable without customer_address in Tables Involved.
proposed_fix: Phase Q3 should verify join paths — every cited multi-table join must have at least one directly shared column name OR an explicit intermediate table in Tables Involved.

evidence: Monte Carlo consolidation claim needs cost data (rent, labor rate) but call_center has only cc_tax_percentage. No cost column cited.
proposed_fix: Feasibility check: for Simulation techniques that claim cost/savings output, require at least one numeric cost-like column in cited tables.

evidence: Trend analysis on call_center (a dimension/reference table, ~1 row per center). Trends over time on a static dimension are meaningless. Mistakes reference table for fact table.
proposed_fix: Reference-table-as-fact guard: when cited Primary Table is classified REFERENCE by data_category_map, block Trend/Forecasting/Cohort techniques unless a fact table is also joined.

evidence: Same join-path bug as N03-U02. 'join call_center and customer on state/zip alignment' without customer_address intermediate.
proposed_fix: See N03-U02 — R4_join_path_executable

evidence: Pearson/Spearman correlation on N=24 call_centers. P-values weak; reviewer would demote to descriptive examination.
proposed_fix: For Correlation Analysis on N<50, flag as WEAK in inspire_score scoring.

evidence: K-means on a single 1-D feature (c_last_review_date_sk - c_first_sales_date_sk). K-means on 1-D is equivalent to NTILE binning — technique over-engineered for the question.
proposed_fix: Technique-minimality check: if Solution uses Clustering with ≤2 engineered features, flag as over-engineered; recommend NTILE/percentile bucketing.
fix_location: Prompt §J SELF-TEST cheaper-alternative clause + Phase G rubric

evidence: 'Cohort analysis by birth year cohort' mixes biology (c_birth_year) with acquisition (c_first_sales_date_sk). Classical Cohort Analysis uses acquisition-date cohorts, not birth cohorts. Two independent signals conflated.
proposed_fix: Cohort-technique guard: if technique=Cohort Analysis, require the cohort-forming column to be a timestamp tied to first-interaction (not biographical).
fix_location: Prompt RULE 11 + Phase Q3 cohort structural check

evidence: Same JOIN-path error: customer lacks state/zip directly. FAILS executable-SQL test.
proposed_fix: Phase Q3 R4_join_path_executable (see N03-U02).

evidence: 3 UCs (N03-U02, N04-U01, N03-U03) all Simulation/Clustering on the same 24-row call_center scope; semantic near-duplicates at the 'consolidation/right-sizing' decision level.
proposed_fix: Q2 canonical dedup should catch same-table + same-decision UCs even when technique labels differ. Add Pass B LLM-judge.

evidence: 14 UCs all use 1 table (trips). Schema has multiple tables (trip_data, zones, etc.) but info_schema bug stripped them. UCs reference driver incentives/shifts/scheduling but trips table has NO driver_id — aspirational recommendations.
proposed_fix: v0.5.24 info_schema DESCRIBE fallback (committed). Re-sweep to confirm. Add Phase L L21_beneficiary_action_feasible — action recommendations must trace to columns that enable them (e.g., driver-targeted actions require driver_id).

evidence: 'Optimize driver shift scheduling' produces recommendations for specific drivers, but trips table has no driver_id column. Recommendations are unactionable (can't assign driver X to shift Y without knowing X exists).
proposed_fix: Phase Q3 add R6_action_column_support: if Solution claims per-subject action (per-driver, per-customer, per-store), require that subject's ID to exist in cited Tables Involved.

evidence: Same — 'Driver incentive targeting' without driver_id column.
proposed_fix: See N03-U02

evidence: 70 UCs on 4 weather tables only (forecast_hourly_imperial, forecast_daily_calendar_imperial, historical_daynight_imperial, forecast_daily_calendar_metric). Accuweather schema typically has 9+ tables; info_schema likely stripped others.
proposed_fix: v0.5.24 fix + re-sweep

evidence: Statement says 'correlate heat index with ENERGY DEMAND'. But no energy data in any weather table. Business Value promises 'grid operator planning' outputs that require energy consumption data not in schema. Classic invented-externality.
proposed_fix: Strengthen Rule 10 (NO INFERRED-EXTERNALITY CLAIMS) — add Phase Q3 R7_business_value_column_backed: every metric claim in Business Value must trace to a column in cited tables, not be derived from domain knowledge.

evidence: 'Predict degree_days_heating from degree_days_heating, degree_days_cooling, temperature_avg, temperature_realfeel_avg, humidity_relative_avg'. This is tautological — the target variable IS in the feature set. Gradient Boosting trained on y->y gives memorized output.
proposed_fix: Phase Q3 R8_target_leakage: if technique is Predictive Modeling/Classification/Regression and Solution cites the target column in feature list, flag as tautological.

evidence: 'HVAC scheduling plan for buildings' — weather tables have no buildings/facilities data. Recommendation has no subject to act on.
proposed_fix: Phase Q3 R6 (see N03-U02)

evidence: 33 UCs all on claims_sample_synthetic. Schema typically has multiple tables (diagnosis, procedure dim, provider, patient) — info_schema bug stripped them.
proposed_fix: v0.5.24 fix + re-sweep

evidence: 'Linear optimization using procedure_code volume... subject to SIMULATED capacity constraints per location'. Constraints are simulated = made up. Revenue claims 'maximize allowed revenue' but without real capacity numbers this is a toy model.
proposed_fix: Phase Q3 R9_no_simulated_constraints: reject UCs whose Solution names 'simulated' or 'synthetic' or 'assumed' for required inputs.

evidence: 91 UCs / 5 Primary Tables. Multi-table 13% (below 30% target). 7 NEXT_ACTIONS. Distribution: 34 trans, 18 reviews, 16 franchises, 12 customers, 11 suppliers — heavily skewed to transactions.
proposed_fix: Continue tuning multi-table mandate; consider per-primary-table quota after v0.5.24 re-sweep

evidence: Pattern across all 4 sweeps: UCs recommend ACTIONS on subjects (drivers, buildings, stores, customers) that have no identifier column in the cited Tables Involved. Solutions are aspirational rather than executable by Genie.
proposed_fix: Add Phase Q3 R6_action_subject_grounded: for every Solution that recommends per-X action, require a column that uniquely identifies X in cited tables. Blocking level.
